response.overview: Through a series of odd encounters, an enigmatic stranger impacts the lives of visitors to a city park one autumn afternoon. In his presence, people experience a range of emotions, unaware of the effect he has on them and their actions. Meanwhile, dogs of all kinds play around them, unbothered by human drama. They run about beside a giant, tumbling inflatable pig, the trickster with a fixed grin. Partly influenced by giallo cinema, Dogs of Mercy Park shows a slice of everyday life punctuated with bursts of joy and fear, and posits that light prevails over darkness.
response.title: Dogs of Mercy Park
